feature_name: Grok Bot automatic model routing (task-based delegation to third-party models including Claude Opus 5.5)
programmatic_access: NOT available. The xAI API (POST /v1/chat/completions) only accepts Grok model IDs (grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-3, etc.). Passing claude-opus-5-5 or anthropic/claude-opus-5-5 as the model parameter will fail with a 404, as those models are not in the xAI catalog. No model-id or toggle in the API can force Opus 5.5 routing; routing is entirely product-managed in Grok Bot.
recommended_recipe: For the fleet's $100 xAI accounts: (1) Use grok.com UI with Expert Mode/Heavy Mode toggled on for complex code/design review work — this prompts Grok Bot to select deeper reasoning models (which may include Opus 5.5 auto-routed). (2) In Grok Build TUI, use /model grok-4.7 to select Grok's flagship model explicitly. (3) As prompt pattern, preface requests with 'As a world-class reviewer, evaluate this for...' to elicit thorough analysis from whatever model Grok selects. (4) Fallback: if Opus 5.5 routing is essential and cannot be auto-routed, use a separate Anthropic Claude Opus 5.5 API key directly (billed separately, not through xAI credit).
summary: xAI Grok now auto-routes to Claude Opus 5.5 for complex tasks (announced Oct 7, 2026), but there is NO user-facing way to force it — not on grok.com UI, not via the xAI API. The routing is automatic, task-based, and product-managed. The xAI API catalog contains only Grok models (grok-4.7, grok-4.6, grok-3). Billing follows the serving model ($4/$20 per MTok for Opus 5.5, $2/$6 for Grok 4.7). Fleet should use Grok Expert Mode + 'world-class reviewer' prompt pattern as the practical workaround, since programmatic forcing of Opus 5.5 through the xAI API is not possible.
